security_problem: SECURITY INVARIANT: On an opted-in session (--capability-eval), the capability evaluator (a deterministic, stdlib-only accounting device) is consulted at tools/call; an evaluator error (unparseable/missing/invalid effect target, missing declared authority, prior-hash mismatch, replay, non-canonical CIDR/host/path, raw/structured target disagreement, malformed declared host/executable, unknown receipt version) is mapped to PAUSE_REQUIRE_NEW_PROOF (reason evaluator_error) and routes to the existing approval gate — NEVER a silent allow. When the flag is off (the default), the NoopEvaluator returns (nil, nil): zero behavioral delta on the existing tools/call decision path. SUPPORTED MODEL: mediated tools/call surface only; ambient MCP-server activity (child processes, server-side egress, unmediated file ops) is NOT observable and is out of scope. ATTACK CLASSES: (1) opted-in evaluator error being swallowed and the call allowed; (2) boundary-request signal with an effect NOT attributable to the declared envelope (E5) reaching ALLOW instead of PAUSE; (3) an empty-Effect file-boundary observation reaching ALLOW instead of a fail-closed evaluator error; (4) args-derived boundary signal with empty structured Effect falling through to the Effect=="" ALLOW branch; (5) false-positive boundary signals from benign payload content (substring shell tokens, non-command arg keys). FAILURE SEMANTICS: every uncertainty and every evaluator error fails closed to PAUSE_REQUIRE_NEW_PROOF (deny-with-proof, zero silent allow). NON-GOALS: NO LLM in the decision path; no new dependency (stdlib only); no ambient (non-mediated) observability claims; no change to audit invariants; no change to public security claims; no auto-deny beyond the pause-to-approval routing.
required_behavior: internal/capability package with the Rev 15 contract surface (Evaluator interface, NoopEvaluator default, ChainEvaluator, 8-kind signal extraction with command-bearing-key-aware args scanning, canonical hash-linked receipt Encode/Decode/Validate, PauseReceipt with stable error_code only) is created; internal/policy/types.go gains the opt-in field; cmd/mcp-visor/main.go wires --capability-eval; internal/proxy/tools_call.go calls the adapter ONLY behind the opt-in flag (default NoopEvaluator = zero behavioral delta). The fail-closed RED test proves an opted-in evaluator error → PAUSE_REQUIRE_NEW_PROOF (reason evaluator_error), never silent allow.
failure_behavior: Fail closed: an opted-in evaluator error or E5 boundary-request signal is PAUSE_REQUIRE_NEW_PROOF and routes to the existing approval gate; never silent allow. Default (flag off) keeps the existing tools/call behavior byte-identical.
non_goals: integrating the evaluator decision into processToolsCall without an explicit opt-in flag
ambient (non-mediated) MCP-server activity observation or completeness claims
LLM verdicts or automatic deny in the decision path
changes to internal/audit invariants or public security claims
envelope extension beyond empty optional sets (declared_executables/declared_network/declared_hosts stay empty by default)
writing .hermes/plans or private notes into the repository

attack_classes.expected: an opted-in evaluator error is mapped to PAUSE_REQUIRE_NEW_PROOF (reason evaluator_error, stable error_code) and never results in a silent allow or forward

a boundary-request signal (host_exec/net_egress) with empty optional declared sets is ALWAYS E5 → PAUSE_REQUIRE_NEW_PROOF; a malformed observed DestHost or raw/structured disagreement is an evaluator error → PAUSE

a file-boundary observation WITHOUT an explicit structured Effect (pre-populated SignalBoundaryFileOutside, or an outside/unresolvable mediated file surface) is UNTYPED → evaluator error → PAUSE, never ALLOW, never a row-8 signal

an args/tool-derived boundary signal with empty Step.Effect binds to the derived kind (host_exec tool name / net_egress DestIP→DestHost→args-URL); an args-only host_exec surface fails closed (evaluator error → PAUSE), never ALLOW

command-invocation signatures are scanned ONLY under command-bearing keys (command/cmd/args/arguments/executable/shell_command); benign payload in non-command keys (content/path/url/output/body) never emits boundary signals and never pauses
